name: concretecms-mcp-server
description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that integrates with Concrete CMS's REST API

CONCRETE_CANONICAL_URL.title: Canonical URL
CONCRETE_CANONICAL_URL.description: The URL of your Concrete CMS site (for example: https://www.example.com)

CONCRETE_API_CLIENT_ID.title: API Integration Client ID
CONCRETE_API_CLIENT_ID.description: The Client ID of the API integration created in your Concrete CMS site

CONCRETE_API_CLIENT_SECRET.title: API Integration Client Secret
CONCRETE_API_CLIENT_SECRET.description: The Client Secret of the API integration created in your Concrete CMS site

CONCRETE_API_SCOPE.title: API Integration Scopes
CONCRETE_API_SCOPE.description: The scopes the connector asks for, separated by spaces (for example: account:read system:info:read pages:read)

HTTP_PORT.title: Sign-in Port
HTTP_PORT.description: The local port used during the sign-in: it must be the port of the Redirect URI of the API integration (by default: http://localhost:3000/callback)

TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY.title: Token Encryption Key
TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: A password used to encrypt the saved tokens: any long random text. If empty, the tokens are saved in plain text

CONCRETE_USER_ID.title: Token File Name
CONCRETE_USER_ID.description: The name used for the files where the tokens are saved

TOKEN_DIR.title: Token Directory
TOKEN_DIR.description: Base directory for storing tokens; per-site subdirectories are created automatically (default: ~/.concretecms-mcp/tokens)

CONCRETE_ALLOW_INSECURE_HTTP.title: Allow insecure HTTP
CONCRETE_ALLOW_INSECURE_HTTP.description: Allow connecting to a Concrete server over plain HTTP instead of HTTPS. For local/development instances only - never enable against a production server

OAUTH_DEBUG.title: OAuth debug mode
OAUTH_DEBUG.description: Log more details about the sign-in

CONCRETE_API_DEBUG.title: Concrete API debug mode
CONCRETE_API_DEBUG.description: Log the requests sent to Concrete CMS and the responses (method, URL, bodies, status) to the log of the extension, for troubleshooting. Sensitive fields are redacted and bodies are truncated

DEBUG_MAX_BODY.title: Debug body limit
DEBUG_MAX_BODY.description: Max number of characters logged for each request/response body in any debug output. Set to 0 to omit bodies from the log entirely
